test_title: PYST 06: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

 # : EKN :: RVN : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : EKN :: RVN : %

Option 1) # = DMK, % = SZQ → DMK : EKN :: RVN : SZQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b21a9dca38e294a39dcd6646925ed39483a74b9fef5f2985cd753adda896059a.png] 

Option 2) # = DHL, % = SYP → DHL : EKN :: RVN : SYP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f8109aa3072d32f8d397e8f768bec88f4acd4b45fd34a3915606f2e94d00290.png] 

Option 3) # = CML, % = PZT → CML : EKN :: RVN : PZT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d88a9cbbdfa5336d061b8f97c07a2b0feaadd6901c1231c8fb7328d02587f3e.png] 

Option 4) # = CIK, % = PYR → CIK : EKN :: RVN : PYR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf07429ad379dda69731659c3867d0465ebba4b0b4e7ee3feafef23896b40ab3.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
